paper_question: When monitoring is sparse, can a shared ecology-time representation use a few observations of a target analyte to reconstruct its missing values in a new river basin?
anti_switching_clause: These endpoints and gates are frozen before new transfer training. Any change requires a new version with a written reason; this file remains immutable.

external_selection.rule: select by data availability only before model results are inspected
external_selection.role: second complete case; no tuning or endpoint changes

primary: relative MAE reduction at K=5 versus the best simple baseline
paired Delta MAE with task-month cluster bootstrap 95% CI

stage3_gate.k_curve: K=5 no worse than K=0 and K=1
stage3_gate.support_integrity: true support beats value-shuffle and site-shuffle
stage3_gate.no_harm: no primary analyte/basin cell worsens by >5% while pooled success is claimed

external_gate.replication: DOC and at least one secondary analyte have the same direction
external_gate.significance: at least one replicated analyte has a cluster-bootstrap CI excluding zero

fallback: If the transfer gate fails, retain the current DOC reconstruction and empirical uncertainty route as the manuscript mainline.
